facts.fact: MINAS says the Registre Social Unique, created by Decree 25/041 of 4 December 2025, has a functional management information system (MIS-DRC) and registered about 465,883 households in 2020-2025, 267,015 of them in 2025.
MINAS says the RSU provides lists of eligible households to the different social programmes, including State ones, under data-sharing protocols.

systems.platform: MIS-DRC web server (cloud) and Android app
